purpose: Measure a conservative GM machine-resource envelope without rerunning or relabeling any behavioral cell.

runtime.d1_effective_noise_semantics: fixed official value 1140; requests are not independent noise draws

measured_fields.whole_device_peak: maximum nvidia-smi memory.used on each assigned GPU, including all task-owned compute processes and driver-visible device overhead
measured_fields.whole_process_peak: maximum sum of nvidia-smi compute-app used_gpu_memory on each assigned GPU
measured_fields.model_load_peak: whole-device and whole-process peaks during the exact model-load interval
measured_fields.model_inference_peak: whole-device and whole-process peaks while the exact six-request fixed-input protocol runs
measured_fields.simulator_peak: whole-device and whole-process peaks from simulator launch through a settled zero-behavioral-action hold
measured_fields.simultaneous_topology_peak: per-device peaks while model runtime and settled simulator are both live; N3 also reports the co-sampled sum across its two visible devices
measured_fields.allocator_peaks: retained exact-runtime PyTorch allocator peaks, kept distinct from nvidia-smi measurements
measured_fields.topology: GPU UUID, name, total bytes, logical assignment, worker identity, pod UID, process ancestry, and verified overlap interval

failure_accounting.child_launch_count_authority: immutable signed and fsynced launch-attempt/outcome receipts around each process-spawn call; only an authenticated successful outcome counts one, an authenticated failed outcome counts zero, and an attempt without an outcome is null
failure_accounting.simulator_count_authority: fsynced hash-chained before/after events around the physical reset and every settling/stability hold; unmatched starts are reported as null with lower and upper bounds
failure_accounting.d1_peer_failure_monitor: the D1 probe is a directly owned child in the queue wrapper process group, polled against the signed simulator-failed receipt every 0.25 seconds and terminated then reaped on failure
failure_accounting.partial_request_count_authority: authenticated N3 event-journal starts/completions or validated D1 server request directories/completion receipts after owned children are stopped; invalid evidence yields null
failure_accounting.behavioral_effect: none; lifecycle accounting creates no model request, robot episode, behavioral action, or label

D1.coordination: hash-bound shared-PVC readiness, completion, and fail-closed peer-lifecycle receipts
D1.peer_failure_markers: simulator_failed, or technical-invalid model_started plus model_done; failure markers have no pass or release authority

release_boundary.claim: A passing probe can freeze only the conservative serial GM machine envelope. It is not a behavioral cell, forecast-accuracy result, annotation result, or evidence for higher concurrency.
